stops.title: Beaten and jailed
stops.text: Paul and Silas had been "shamefully treated" in Philippi, a Roman colony, before coming to Thessalonica.

stops.title: The church addressed
stops.text: A busy port and the capital of Macedonia, where Paul founded the church and had to leave in haste.

stops.title: Where Paul sends Timothy
stops.text: Left alone in Athens, Paul sends Timothy back to strengthen the Thessalonians.

stops.title: Where Paul writes
stops.text: Timothy rejoins Paul with good news, and Paul writes. Corinth isn't named in the letter; it is inferred from Acts.

real.label: Map of northern Greece and the Aegean, drawn from real coordinates. Numbered stops mark Philippi, Thessalonica, Athens, and Corinth.
